    Design Model Configs (🧪Beta)

    albert.resources.design_model_configs

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    MaskEntry

    One feature-mask entry: a family selector or a quantity descriptor.
    MaskEntryRead

    A mask entry as read from the service. A known kind parses to its model (a
    PreviewCount

    How many preview rows or columns to return: a positive number, or "all".
    DesignModelConfigOperation

    A builder operation on a draft design model config.

    MaskEntry 

    MaskEntry = Annotated[
    FamilySelector
    | IngredientAmountOperand
    | LabelFractionOperand
    | ParameterOperand
    | PropertyAggregationOperand,
    Field(discriminator="type"),
]

    One feature-mask entry: a family selector or a quantity descriptor.

    MaskEntryRead 

    MaskEntryRead = Annotated[
    _ReadFamilySelector | QuantityOperandRead,
    Field(union_mode="left_to_right"),
]

    A mask entry as read from the service. A known kind parses to its model (a FamilySelector or a quantity descriptor) and keeps fields this version does not model; an unknown kind parses to UnknownDescriptor.

    PreviewCount 

    PreviewCount = PositiveInt | Literal['all']

    How many preview rows or columns to return: a positive number, or "all".

    DesignModelConfigOperation 

    DesignModelConfigOperation = Annotated[
    SetOutputOperation
    | RemoveComponentOperation
    | UpdateComponentOperation,
    Field(discriminator="op"),
]

    A builder operation on a draft design model config.

    RemoveComponentOperation and UpdateComponentOperation are the same classes design spaces use; here the path is outputs/<target id>.

    DesignModelConfigState

    Bases: StrEnum

    Lifecycle of a design model config. Orthogonal to its soft-delete status.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    DRAFT
    PUBLISHED

    DRAFT 

    DRAFT = 'draft'

    PUBLISHED 

    PUBLISHED = 'published'

    CATEGORICAL

    CATEGORICAL 

    CATEGORICAL = 'categorical'

    FamilySelector

    Bases: TypedDesignModel

    A mask entry matching every default feature of one family.

    Show JSON schema: 
    {
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "A mask entry matching every default feature of one family.",
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "description": "Which family to match: all ingredient amounts, label fractions, ingredient\nproperty aggregations, or parameters.",
      "enum": [
        "allIngredientAmounts",
        "allLabelFractions",
        "allIngredientProperties",
        "allParameters"
      ],
      "title": "Type",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "type"
  ],
  "title": "FamilySelector",
  "type": "object"
}

    Config:

    • extra: forbid
    • revalidate_instances: subclass-instances

    Fields:

    • type (Literal['allIngredientAmounts', 'allLabelFractions', 'allIngredientProperties', 'allParameters'])

    type 

    type: Literal[
    "allIngredientAmounts",
    "allLabelFractions",
    "allIngredientProperties",
    "allParameters",
]

    Which family to match: all ingredient amounts, label fractions, ingredient property aggregations, or parameters.

    FeatureMask

    Bases: BaseAlbertModel

    Which features an output uses: exactly one of include or exclude.

    Each is a non-empty list of mask entries. An output with no mask uses all features.

    Show JSON schema: 
    {
  "$defs": {
    "AggregationBasis": {
      "description": "How an aggregation combines the member values of its scope.",
      "enum": [
        "mean",
        "sum"
      ],
      "title": "AggregationBasis",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "FamilySelector": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "A mask entry matching every default feature of one family.",
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "description": "Which family to match: all ingredient amounts, label fractions, ingredient\nproperty aggregations, or parameters.",
          "enum": [
            "allIngredientAmounts",
            "allLabelFractions",
            "allIngredientProperties",
            "allParameters"
          ],
          "title": "Type",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "title": "FamilySelector",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "IngredientAmountOperand": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "The amount of one ingredient in the formulation.",
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "ingredientAmount",
          "default": "ingredientAmount",
          "description": "Descriptor kind; fixed to ``ingredientAmount``.",
          "title": "Type",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "ingredient": {
          "description": "The inventory ID (format ``INV...``) of the ingredient.",
          "title": "Ingredient",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "ingredient"
      ],
      "title": "IngredientAmountOperand",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "LabelFractionOperand": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "The summed fraction of a label's member ingredients.",
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "labelFraction",
          "default": "labelFraction",
          "description": "Descriptor kind; fixed to ``labelFraction``.",
          "title": "Type",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "label": {
          "description": "A platform tag (format ``TAG...``) or a local label key (``local:...``).",
          "title": "Label",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "label"
      ],
      "title": "LabelFractionOperand",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "ParameterOperand": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "The value of one parameter, addressed by its composite key.",
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "parameter",
          "default": "parameter",
          "description": "Descriptor kind; fixed to ``parameter``.",
          "title": "Type",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "parameter": {
          "description": "The composite parameter key, ``{DAT|PRG}#PRM[#UNI]``.",
          "title": "Parameter",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "parameter"
      ],
      "title": "ParameterOperand",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "PropertyAggregationOperand": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "An aggregation of one inventory property over a scope of ingredients.",
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "propertyAggregation",
          "default": "propertyAggregation",
          "description": "Descriptor kind; fixed to ``propertyAggregation``.",
          "title": "Type",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "basis": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AggregationBasis",
          "description": "How the member values combine: ``mean`` or ``sum``."
        },
        "property": {
          "description": "Name of the aggregated inventory property.",
          "title": "Property",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "label": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "string"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "default": null,
          "description": "Restrict the aggregation to a label's members. Omit to scope to all ingredients.",
          "title": "Label"
        },
        "impute": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            {
              "type": "number"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "default": null,
          "description": "How missing property values are handled: ``True`` fills the column mean, a number\nfills that constant, ``False`` fails on a sparse table. Omit to leave it unstated.",
          "title": "Impute"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "basis",
        "property"
      ],
      "title": "PropertyAggregationOperand",
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Which features an output uses: exactly one of ``include`` or ``exclude``.\n\nEach is a non-empty list of mask entries. An output with no mask uses all features.",
  "properties": {
    "include": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "items": {
            "discriminator": {
              "mapping": {
                "allIngredientAmounts": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                "allIngredientProperties": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                "allLabelFractions": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                "allParameters": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                "ingredientAmount": "#/$defs/IngredientAmountOperand",
                "labelFraction": "#/$defs/LabelFractionOperand",
                "parameter": "#/$defs/ParameterOperand",
                "propertyAggregation": "#/$defs/PropertyAggregationOperand"
              },
              "propertyName": "type"
            },
            "oneOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/FamilySelector"
              },
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/IngredientAmountOperand"
              },
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/LabelFractionOperand"
              },
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ParameterOperand"
              },
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/PropertyAggregationOperand"
              }
            ]
          },
          "minItems": 1,
          "type": "array"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "description": "Use only the features these entries match.",
      "title": "Include"
    },
    "exclude": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "items": {
            "discriminator": {
              "mapping": {
                "allIngredientAmounts": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                "allIngredientProperties": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                "allLabelFractions": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                "allParameters": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                "ingredientAmount": "#/$defs/IngredientAmountOperand",
                "labelFraction": "#/$defs/LabelFractionOperand",
                "parameter": "#/$defs/ParameterOperand",
                "propertyAggregation": "#/$defs/PropertyAggregationOperand"
              },
              "propertyName": "type"
            },
            "oneOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/FamilySelector"
              },
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/IngredientAmountOperand"
              },
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/LabelFractionOperand"
              },
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ParameterOperand"
              },
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/PropertyAggregationOperand"
              }
            ]
          },
          "minItems": 1,
          "type": "array"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "description": "Use every feature except those these entries match.",
      "title": "Exclude"
    }
  },
  "title": "FeatureMask",
  "type": "object"
}

    Config:

    • extra: forbid
    • revalidate_instances: subclass-instances

    Fields:

    • include (list[MaskEntry] | None)
    • exclude (list[MaskEntry] | None)

    Validators:

    • _exactly_one_list

    model_config 

    model_config = ConfigDict(
    extra="forbid",
    revalidate_instances="subclass-instances",
)

    include 

    include: list[MaskEntry] | None = None

    Use only the features these entries match.

    exclude 

    exclude: list[MaskEntry] | None = None

    Use every feature except those these entries match.

    OutputEntry

    Bases: BaseAlbertModel

    One predicted target's wiring, keyed by target ID in a config's outputs.

    Fields the SDK does not model are kept as extra fields and sent back unchanged.

    Show JSON schema: 
    {
  "$defs": {

    "FamilySelector": {

      "description": "A mask entry matching every default feature of one family.",
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "description": "Which family to match: all ingredient amounts, label fractions, ingredient\nproperty aggregations, or parameters.",
          "enum": [
            "allIngredientAmounts",
            "allLabelFractions",
            "allIngredientProperties",
            "allParameters"

    "FeatureMask": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "Which features an output uses: exactly one of ``include`` or ``exclude``.\n\nEach is a non-empty list of mask entries. An output with no mask uses all features.",

        "include": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "items": {
                "discriminator": {
                  "mapping": {
                    "allIngredientAmounts": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                    "allIngredientProperties": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                    "allLabelFractions": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                    "allParameters": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",

                    "parameter": "#/$defs/ParameterOperand",
                    "propertyAggregation": "#/$defs/PropertyAggregationOperand"

                  "propertyName": "type"
                },
                "oneOf": [
                  {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/FamilySelector"
                  },
                  {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/IngredientAmountOperand"
                  },
                  {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/LabelFractionOperand"
                  },
                  {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/ParameterOperand"
                  },
                  {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/PropertyAggregationOperand"
                  }
                ]
              },
              "minItems": 1,
              "type": "array"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "default": null,
          "description": "Use only the features these entries match.",
          "title": "Include"
        },
        "exclude": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "items": {
                "discriminator": {
                  "mapping": {
                    "allIngredientAmounts": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                    "allIngredientProperties": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                    "allLabelFractions": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                    "allParameters": "#/$defs/FamilySelector",
                    "ingredientAmount": "#/$defs/IngredientAmountOperand",
                    "labelFraction": "#/$defs/LabelFractionOperand",
                    "parameter": "#/$defs/ParameterOperand",
                    "propertyAggregation": "#/$defs/PropertyAggregationOperand"
                  },
                  "propertyName": "type"
                },
                "oneOf": [
                  {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/FamilySelector"
                  },
                  {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/IngredientAmountOperand"
                  },
                  {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/LabelFractionOperand"
                  },
                  {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/ParameterOperand"
                  },
                  {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/PropertyAggregationOperand"

        },

          "$ref": "#/$defs/AggregationBasis",
          "description": "How the member values combine: ``mean`` or ``sum``."
        },
        "property": {

          "anyOf": [

            {

      "required": [

        "property"
      ],
      "title": "PropertyAggregationOperand",
      "type": "object"

    DesignModelConfig

    Bases: _DesignRecord

    A design model config: which targets to predict, how to transform them, and which default features each one uses.

    A config is created as a draft, edited with builder operations, checked against a smart dataset, and published. A published config is frozen; editing one means forking it into a new draft.

    Fields this version does not model are kept as extra fields when a config is read.

    validate_ 

    validate_: bool = False

    Whether to fold a check into the result.

    preview 

    preview: DesignModelConfigPreviewRequest | None = None

    A feature preview to fold into the result. Needs smart_dataset_id.

    resolve 

    resolve: bool = False

    Whether to fold the resolved features into the result. Needs smart_dataset_id.

    dry_run 

    dry_run: bool = False

    Compute the would-be result without saving it.

    smart_dataset_id 

    smart_dataset_id: SmartDatasetId | None = None

    Smart dataset (format SDT...) for the folded checks.
